name: Vidar's Sandal
lore: A sandal of impossible thickness, reinforced with leather scraps collected over an entire lifetime. Vidar the Silent, son of Odin, wore it when he avenged his father — planting his foot on the lower jaw of the World-Wolf and tearing the beast apart with his bare hands.
_design_note: MEGA-SECRET quest reward. AC is modest (1 + leather material bonus) — the value is the instant-kill on Fenrir, not the defensive line. peak_weight 0.0 ensures it never natural-spawns; the altar assembly path is the only way in. Code references: src/game_combat.py:1292-1311 (instant-kill trigger), src/game_divine.py:499-521 (altar assembly), src/dungeon.py:2145-2154 (altar carve). See tools/balance/systems/bosses_and_quests.md §Fenrir Quest Layer 2.
